DEFENDANTS XINGWEI LU AND OREN KISLEV ARE PRESENT. HEARD WITH RELATED CASE CSM-22-865551. LITIGATES ORALLY STIPULATED TO ALLOW THIS CASE TO BE HEARD BEFORE A JUDGE PRO TEM. HONORABLE GREG GROENEVELD CONTINUES THESE CASES FOR ISSUES REGARDING BOTH THE PLAINTIFF AND THE DEFENDANTS CASES. PLAINTIFF NEEDS TO ADDRESS WHETHER HE IS THE REAL PARTY OF INTEREST, AND IF HE HAS SPLIT HIS CAUSES OF ACTION TO COME WITHIN THE JURISDICTIONAL LIMITS OF THIS COURT.
